### From `packages/core/src/model-calls.ts`

#### <a id="core-modelforward"></a>`ModelForward`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/model-calls.ts`

A non-chat model call a system forwards to the hub (the `model` link endpoint), by modality.

```ts
type ModelForward = ({
  modality: "embed";
  texts: string[];
  model?: {
    model: string;
  } | {
    category: string;
  } | {
    auto: {
      cost?: number | undefined;
      speed?: number | undefined;
      accuracy?: number | undefined;
    };
  } | undefined;
} | {
  modality: "image";
  prompt: string;
  model?: {
    model: string;
  } | {
    category: string;
  } | {
    auto: {
      cost?: number | undefined;
      speed?: number | undefined;
      accuracy?: number | undefined;
    };
  } | undefined;
  size?: string | undefined;
  count?: number | undefined;
} | {
  modality: "transcribe";
  audio: {
    hash: string;
    size: number;
    mime: string;
  };
  model?: {
    model: string;
  } | {
    category: string;
  } | {
    auto: {
      cost?: number | undefined;
      speed?: number | undefined;
      accuracy?: number | undefined;
    };
  } | undefined;
  language?: string | undefined;
} | {
  modality: "speech";
  text: string;
  model?: {
    model: string;
  } | {
    category: string;
  } | {
    auto: {
      cost?: number | undefined;
      speed?: number | undefined;
      accuracy?: number | undefined;
    };
  } | undefined;
  voice?: string | undefined;
  format?: "mp3" | "wav" | "ogg" | undefined;
}) & {
  run?: string | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-modelforwardresult"></a>`ModelForwardResult`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/model-calls.ts`

What a forwarded non-chat call gives back, by modality, with its record and cost. Large outputs come by ref.

```ts
type ModelForwardResult = ({
  modality: "embed";
  vectors: number[][];
} | {
  modality: "image";
  images: {
    hash: string;
    size: number;
    mime: string;
  }[];
} | {
  modality: "transcribe";
  text: string;
  segments?: {
    start: number;
    end: number;
    text: string;
  }[] | undefined;
} | {
  modality: "speech";
  audio: {
    hash: string;
    size: number;
    mime: string;
  };
}) & {
  call: string;
  cost: number;
  model: string;
};
```
